name: Bohuňov (Czechia)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over red, with a white triangle issuing from the hoist edge reaching half the flag's length.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 26 November 1999 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
